svg.title: SCHNEIZEL.DEV — 3d · earlier portfolio
svg.desc: My earlier portfolio, as an explorable 3D scene. A solar-system portfolio built with React Three Fiber: project pods to fly to, a telemetry HUD and a terminal dock. Built with Next.js, React Three Fiber, Three.js, Zustand. Live at schneizeldev.vercel.app.
